product.title: Cortech Ligature Resistant HookMax Wall Hook - HM
product.body_html:
The Cortech HookMax is a ligature resistant hook that releases at maximum 10 lb load. Once released, the hook bends, forcing ligature to slide off, and then retains its shape.

  • Ligature resistant hooks made of PC/ABS (core) and TPU (outer piece)
  • Dimensions: H 2.05" x W 1.24" x D .85"
  • 360° Release at maximum 10 lbs
  • Resistant to alcohol and most detergents
  • Available in a variety of colors
  • 3 Year Warranty applies to ascribed use; Full Warranty against manufacturing defects
  • Sold in packs of 5, price is per pack

About Cortech HookMax Series Anti-Ligature Hooks
Cortech's innovative ligature-resistant hooks for Behavioral Health and Correctional Environments - the HookMax and HookMax Plus - are carefully constructed with a PC/ABS core material and a flexible yet robust TPU outer material. Unlike a typical hook, the HookMax and HookMax Plus safely bend and release ligature at a maximum of 10lb and 20 lbs, respectively. Once the ligature slides off, the hooks retain their shape and function for continued use. Each ligature resistant hook has a “normalized” design to invoke comfort. However, the unique choice of materials combined with specific details makes them both safe and functional for many applications, including both individual resident rooms and common areas alike.

About Cortech USA:
Cortech USA (Correctional Technologies) manufactures products that are exceptionally durable, designed for use in compassionate and normative behavioral healthcare, corrections, law enforcement, heavy use commercial and industrial environments, parks and recreation, schools, universities, hospitals, emergency and homeless shelters, and other institutions and facilities where safety and durability matter. Cortech products are ideal for extreme use and intensive use environments.
